rules: transition is not emitted until issue 238 defines it

separation_policy.boundary_layer: StructureV1 consumes neutral bar-synchronous signals and emits neutral sections or boundary candidates only.
separation_policy.role_layer: Arrangement scoring consumes neutral sections plus role signals and may later emit roles from the issue 238 vocabulary.
forbidden: StructureV1 must not emit intro, groove, build, drop, breakdown, outro, unknown, transition, or drop_onset as section labels.
Arrangement scoring must not rewrite boundary positions as a substitute for StructureV1.
All-In-One labels, CLAP labels, or stem labels must not be treated as Techno ground truth.

allowed: local median and MAD robust z-score
relative share inside the same track
rolling 4 bar, 8 bar, and 16 bar trend
forbidden: fixed role cutoffs before private pilot evidence
invented confidence when a signal is missing

signals.name: bar_grid
signals.meaning: Bar index and bar time range derived from downbeats on the shared audio timebase.
signals.source_calculation: Use analysis.timeline.downbeats.times_sec when available; derive half-open bar ranges against the Track Map timebase and duration.
signals.normalization: none; the grid is positional reference data
signals.provenance: BeatGrid component provenance from issue 236 plus Track Map timebase from issue 234.
signals.missing_signal_behavior: If downbeats are missing, StructureV1 may stay not_run or partial; do not estimate roles from seconds-only windows.

signals.name: relative_track_position
signals.meaning: Relative bar position within the track. This is a weak role context signal, not a boundary signal.
signals.source_calculation: Compute bar index divided by total bar count from the downbeat grid and Track Map duration.
signals.normalization: relative position within the same track
signals.provenance: Derived role-context signal from BeatGrid and Track Map timebase; no musical analysis backend of its own.
signals.missing_signal_behavior: Nullable when total bars cannot be derived; do not use absolute seconds as a role substitute.

signals.name: bar_energy_rms
signals.meaning: Per-bar RMS energy or dBFS loudness contour.
signals.source_calculation: Aggregate the Track Map energy grid into downbeat-defined bars; if the producer emits a future bar-synchronous energy block, consume that directly.
signals.normalization: track percentile and median/MAD robust z-score
signals.provenance: Energy component configuration, value_kind, unit, window_sec, hop_sec, and source_ref.
signals.missing_signal_behavior: Nullable; boundary and role paths continue with lower evidence and no replacement confidence.

signals.name: bar_loudness_delta
signals.meaning: Local loudness change before and after each bar or section boundary.
signals.source_calculation: Compute previous/next and rolling loudness deltas from bar_energy_rms or another documented loudness series.
signals.normalization: local delta against neighboring bars; robust z-score within the track
signals.provenance: Derived from the same provenance as the source energy/loudness series plus StructureV1 config.
signals.missing_signal_behavior: Nullable; do not infer drop_onset or build solely from section order.

signals.name: low_end_share
signals.meaning: Relative low-frequency energy share per bar. This is a low-end proxy, not confirmed bass activity.
signals.source_calculation: Band-energy ratio from audio spectrum using the same working audio and bar grid.
signals.provenance: StructureV1 spectral/low-end component with band definition in configuration.
signals.missing_signal_behavior: Nullable; never relabel it as bass_activity unless a stem or explicit bass detector produced that signal.

signals.name: onset_density
signals.meaning: Count or normalized density of detected onsets per bar.
signals.source_calculation: Onset envelope or onset picks aggregated into downbeat-defined bars.
signals.normalization: track percentile and rolling local delta
signals.provenance: StructureV1 onset component with onset method and parameters in configuration.
signals.missing_signal_behavior: Nullable; rhythm roles remain unknown or lower evidence rather than guessed.

signals.name: rhythm_stability
signals.meaning: How stable the onset pattern and beat-aligned activity remain over adjacent bars.
signals.source_calculation: Compare bar-level onset envelopes or rhythmic descriptors across neighboring bars.
signals.normalization: relative stability percentile within the track
signals.provenance: StructureV1 rhythm component plus BeatGrid provenance.
signals.missing_signal_behavior: Nullable; do not treat a missing rhythmic signal as silence or instability.

signals.name: timbre_delta
signals.meaning: Bar-to-bar or section-to-section change in timbral descriptor space.
signals.source_calculation: Compare MFCC-like or other documented timbre descriptors computed by StructureV1; public Track Map v1 does not expose raw MFCC arrays.
signals.normalization: local delta and robust z-score within the track
signals.provenance: StructureV1 timbre component with descriptor family and parameters in configuration.
signals.missing_signal_behavior: Nullable; role scoring must continue without fabricating timbre change.

signals.name: spectral_delta
signals.meaning: Change in spectral shape or band distribution across bars.
signals.source_calculation: Compute bar-level spectral centroid, rolloff, flux, or band-ratio deltas from the working audio.
signals.provenance: StructureV1 spectral component; global brightness is only a fallback context field, not a bar series.
signals.missing_signal_behavior: Nullable; do not replace it with global brightness as if it were bar-synchronous.

signals.name: self_similarity
signals.meaning: Similarity matrix or per-bar similarity summary showing repeated musical material.
signals.source_calculation: Build a bar-level self-similarity representation from energy, timbre, rhythm, and spectral descriptors.
signals.provenance: StructureV1 similarity component with descriptor inputs listed in configuration.
signals.missing_signal_behavior: Nullable; neutral boundaries can still use novelty/energy deltas if present.

signals.name: recurrence
signals.meaning: Detected recurrence or repeated-bar structure across the track.
signals.source_calculation: Recurrence plot or repeated-segment summary derived from the self-similarity representation.
signals.provenance: StructureV1 recurrence component with recurrence parameters in configuration.
signals.missing_signal_behavior: Nullable; no role confidence boost may be created from absence of recurrence.

signals.name: novelty
signals.meaning: Local novelty curve indicating candidate neutral boundaries.
signals.source_calculation: Compute novelty from self-similarity or multi-feature deltas around each bar.
signals.provenance: StructureV1 novelty component with kernel/window configuration.
signals.missing_signal_behavior: Nullable; #265 may still emit lower-evidence sections from other boundary signals.

signals.name: neighbor_delta
signals.meaning: Before/after difference around each candidate boundary across energy, low-end, onset, timbre, and spectral signals.
signals.source_calculation: Compare previous and next bar windows around a bar index or neutral boundary candidate.
signals.normalization: local robust z-score relative to neighboring bars
signals.provenance: StructureV1 derived signal referencing all source feature components used.
signals.missing_signal_behavior: Nullable per source feature; compute only from available declared inputs and preserve missing-input notes.

signals.name: multi_bar_trend
signals.meaning: 4, 8, and 16 bar rise, fall, or stability trends for energy, low-end, onsets, timbre, and spectrum.
signals.source_calculation: Rolling trend over downbeat-aligned windows of 4, 8, and 16 bars.
signals.normalization: slope and percentile relative to the same track
signals.provenance: StructureV1 trend component with window lengths recorded in configuration.
signals.missing_signal_behavior: Nullable for tracks shorter than the requested window; no fallback trend is invented.

signals.name: neutral_section_boundary
signals.meaning: Neutral section ranges produced by StructureV1 without arrangement roles.
signals.source_calculation: Boundary backend combines available neutral signals and emits Track Map sections with neutral labels only.
signals.provenance: StructureV1 component provenance, status, configuration, and quality notes.
signals.missing_signal_behavior: If sections are not_run, failed, or no_result, Arrangement Map generation must not classify roles.

signals.name: evidence_completeness
signals.meaning: Per-section accounting of available, missing, failed, and contradictory signal evidence.
signals.source_calculation: Summarize the status and nullable values of the signals consumed by a later role scorer.
signals.normalization: not a confidence score; report counts and missing categories relative to the attempted signal set
signals.provenance: Derived by the Arrangement Map scorer from declared input signal statuses; records input source_refs rather than inventing a new audio backend.
signals.missing_signal_behavior: Always computable as metadata when role scoring is attempted; it records missing inputs instead of replacing them.

signals.name: stem_drum_activity
signals.meaning: Confirmed drum stem activity per bar, if a future stem pipeline supplies it.
signals.source_calculation: Aggregate drum stem energy/onsets over the same bar grid.
signals.provenance: Optional stem component provenance; never required for #265.
signals.missing_signal_behavior: Optional and nullable; absence does not degrade MVP boundary detection or role scoring.

signals.name: stem_bass_activity
signals.meaning: Confirmed bass stem activity per bar, if a future stem pipeline supplies it.
signals.source_calculation: Aggregate bass stem energy/pitch-presence over the same bar grid.
signals.provenance: Optional stem component provenance; never required for #265.
signals.missing_signal_behavior: Optional and nullable; do not substitute low_end_share as confirmed bass activity.

signals.name: semantic_role_hint
signals.meaning: Optional semantic embedding hint for arrangement role scoring after separate evidence exists.
signals.source_calculation: Future CLAP or other embedding comparison against documented prompts or references.
signals.normalization: track-relative or calibration-set relative, only after evidence
signals.provenance: Optional semantic component provenance; not part of #265 MVP and not Techno truth.
signals.missing_signal_behavior: Optional and nullable; absence must not lower confidence by itself.
